English.Char_Desc_2000:
Windows Apache with Multi PHP (WAMP Web Stack) is a portable local web development environment for Windows. It packages Apache 2.4, multiple PHP versions, a local mail catcher (Mailpit), an FTP server, phpMyAdmin, and a web control panel so you can build and test dynamic sites offline before publishing.
Key features: - Apache 2.4 (Apache Lounge Win32) with FastCGI PHP workers - Multi-PHP: add any php* folder with php-cgi.exe; ports are assigned automatically - Per-site PHP version selection from the control panel - Mailpit for local SMTP testing (SMTP 1025, UI 8025) - Plain FTP server on port 2121 with accounts managed in the panel - Web control panel at http://localhost/panel/ for Overview, Sites, PHP Config, logs, database tools, and FTP - System tray helper and simple start.bat / stop.bat scripts - Portable install folder — place the stack anywhere on disk
Quick start: 1. Download ApachePHPWindows.exe (or the ZIP package) from GitHub Releases or SourceForge 2. Install or extract to a folder such as C:\web 3. Run start.bat (allow Windows Firewall if prompted) 4. Open http://localhost/panel/ to manage the stack 5. Put site files under htdocs
Requirements: Windows 8 or later, Visual C++ Redistributable (x86). Optional: MySQL or MariaDB on 127.0.0.1:3306 for database tools and phpMyAdmin.
Project links: - SourceForge: https://sourceforge.net/projects/windows-apache-with-multi-php/ - GitHub: https://github.com/amolpatil2025/WAMPP_Windows - Download: https://github.com/amolpatil2025/WAMPP_Windows/releases/download/1.5/ApachePHPWindows.exe
Ideal for students, freelancers, and developers who need a lightweight, multi-PHP Windows alternative to heavier WAMP/XAMPP setups, with mail and FTP included for realistic local testing.
